scope: Entire relocation quarantine preparation/cancellation and relocation retention planning/verification modules
checks: Retention excludes evidence, configured sources, pending operations and unverified roots
Independent recovery inode and exact bytes required; hardlinks do not count as independent recovery
Plan binds configuration, reference hashes, cutoff and source/recovery identities
Preparation copies to exclusive journaled files, retains partial/unknown data and refuses substituted ownership
Cancellation is immutable and retains bytes; commit/purge intent prevents cancellation
